text: Pick one of the six sources. cc compiles it to a .com image: CALL main, HLT, then code, then the globals in declaration order.
run loads the image at 0x0100 (the TPA). The bright cells near the top of the tape are the stack; locals and return addresses live there.
Every putchar is an OUT 1 with A=2 (CONOUT). Watch RUNNING -> SYSCALL -> RUNNING once per character.
echo.c calls CONIN. With nothing typed the BIOS answers BIOS_WAIT and the kernel parks in IDLE until you press a key.
In strcat.c and memtest.c the head walks the global arrays byte by byte; in count.c the digits[] buffer fills right-to-left before it is printed.
